title: stevia jorullensis var. ehrenbergiana
intro: Stevia jorullensis var. ehrenbergiana, commonly known as Mexican stevia, is a plant species within the Stevia genus, known for its sweet-tasting leaves that are used as a natural sweetener. The plant has been found to have several health benefits, including reducing blood pressure and sugar levels, as well as exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Stevia jorullensis var. ehrenbergiana include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and its potential to treat conditions such as diabetes and hypertension. The bioactive constituents of the plant include steviol glycosides, particularly stevioside and rebaudioside, which are responsible for its sweet taste and medicinal properties.
